decisions.reason: Requiring the correct sensor-board BOM does not change the component-sourceability policy; the shunt-package question does not establish a new package selection.
Generating the correct sensor-board BOM does not change the separate obligation to assist with manufacturer order setup.
The sensor-board BOM correction does not alter whether KiCad project resources resolve portably.
The BOM correction does not change the requirement to hardwire the SPS30 SEL pin to ground for I2C operation.
Requesting a correct sensor-board BOM leaves all interboard connector types, pinouts, and topology unchanged.
The source requires documentation matching the sensor-board design but does not modify the existing sensor connector inventory or pinouts.
The sensor-board BOM requirement does not modify the ESP32 breakout; the separate same-message pin-count uncertainty is already represented as an AMBIGUOUS Event.
The sensor-board BOM correction does not change main-board dimensions, placement, orientation, or connector-layout requirements.
The sensor-board BOM requirement does not change monitored rails or monitoring topology; the unresolved shunt-package question establishes no new monitoring value.
Generating the correct BOM does not alter the sensor board's mechanical orientation, connector placement, or accessibility constraints.
The BOM correction does not change the decision to omit on-board level shifting and use 3.3V-compatible logic.
The sensor-board BOM requirement has no effect on DCDC1 voltage configuration or 3.3V rail regulation.
